title: Pasha Knows Everything
author: Lantern Original
summaryTr: Tom'un yeni papağanı Pasha duyduğu her şeyi yüksek sesle tekrar ediyor. Üstelik bu akşam Tom'un patronu yemeğe geliyor ve Tom, patronu hakkında pek de güzel şeyler söylememişti.
paragraphs: Tom has a new parrot. It is big and green. Its name is Pasha.
Pasha is very clever. He hears every word. Then he says it again, very loudly.
Tom's wife, Ayla, is not happy about this.
"Be careful, Tom," she says. "Pasha hears everything."
"I am always careful," says Tom.
"No, you are not. Every evening you say, 'My boss is boring.' And Pasha hears you."
"Only from Monday to Friday," says Tom.
Ayla looks at him. "Tom, listen. Tonight Mr. Grant is coming for dinner."
Tom's face goes white. "Tonight? Mr. Grant? My boss?"
"Yes. He comes at seven. Pasha stays in the bedroom. And you say only nice things. Only nice things!"
"OK, OK," says Tom.
At six o'clock, Ayla puts Pasha in the bedroom and closes the door. Pasha is very quiet. Tom does not like it.
At seven, the doorbell rings. Mr. Grant is a tall man with a very yellow tie.
"Good evening, Mr. Grant!" says Tom. "What a beautiful tie!"
"Thank you," says Mr. Grant. "My wife hates it."
"She is wrong," says Tom quickly.
They sit at the table. Ayla brings the soup.
"Mmm," says Mr. Grant. "This soup is very good."
Tom smiles. Ayla smiles. Everything is fine.
Then a loud voice comes from the bedroom.
"GRANT IS BORING! GRANT IS BORING!"
Nobody moves. Mr. Grant puts down his spoon.
"What is that?" he asks.
"The TV," says Tom.
"The TV says my name?"
"It is a... new program," says Tom. "About a man called Grant. A different Grant. A very exciting Grant."
"UGLY TIE! UGLY TIE!" shouts the voice.
Mr. Grant looks at his tie. "That is a strange program."
Ayla laughs very loudly. "Ha ha ha! More soup, Mr. Grant?"
Then there is a small click. The bedroom door opens. Pasha walks into the room. He walks across the floor and climbs onto the table. He stops next to Mr. Grant's plate.
Mr. Grant looks at the parrot. The parrot looks at Mr. Grant.
"Pasha?" says Mr. Grant.
"Hello, Grant!" says Pasha.
"That is MY parrot!" says Mr. Grant. "I gave him to the pet shop last month!"
Tom looks at Ayla. Ayla looks at Tom.
"We bought him at the pet shop," she says in a small voice.
"Why did you give him away?" asks Tom.
Mr. Grant's face goes red. "No reason. More soup, please."
Pasha opens his mouth. Now his voice is deep. It is Mr. Grant's voice.
"Tom is the best worker in the office!"
Tom's mouth opens. "What?"
"But I never tell him," says the deep voice. "Because Tom wants my job!"
Nobody says a word.
"The parrot is lying," says Mr. Grant.
"TOM WANTS MY JOB! TOM WANTS MY JOB!" shouts Pasha.
Mr. Grant looks at Tom. "Do you want my job?"
Tom looks at his soup. He looks at Ayla. She looks out of the window.
"Yes," says Tom. "A little."
For a long time, Mr. Grant says nothing. Then he starts to laugh.
"An honest man," he says. "OK, Tom. Next month you get a bigger office and a better job."
"Really? Thank you, Mr. Grant!"
"Not MY job," says Mr. Grant. "A different job."
"Of course!"
"And one more thing. This parrot knows every secret in my house. Please keep him in YOUR house."
"GRANT SINGS IN THE SHOWER!" shouts Pasha. "GRANT SINGS IN THE SHOWER!"
Mr. Grant closes his eyes.
"Ayla," he says. "Do you have a very big blanket?"

phrases.tr: Ne güzel bir kravat! (What a + sıfat + isim = ünlem)

quiz.q: Why does Ayla put Pasha in the bedroom?
options: Tom's boss is coming for dinner.
She wants to clean the room.
quiz.explainTr: Ayla, Pasha her şeyi tekrar ettiği için onu yatak odasına koyar; Tom'un patronu Mr. Grant yemeğe gelmektedir.

quiz.q: What does Tom say the voice from the bedroom is?
quiz.explainTr: Tom, sesin televizyonda yeni bir programdan geldiğini söyler.

quiz.q: Where did Mr. Grant give Pasha away?
quiz.explainTr: Mr. Grant papağanı geçen ay evcil hayvan dükkânına vermiştir.

quiz.q: What does Mr. Grant give Tom at the end?
options: A bigger office and a better job
quiz.explainTr: Mr. Grant, Tom'a daha büyük bir ofis ve daha iyi bir iş verir, ama kendi işini değil.
